purpose: Equivalent-function Debian migration, not additional desktop features

physicalAcceptance.limits: No independently supplied per-GPU, connector or performance measurements

acceptance: Memory-only unsigned UEFI optical and GPT/FAT32 USB boot without internal disk writes
Ordinary-user PAM/login1 session with DRM and libinput
Raster and GLES paths identified separately; no hidden acceleration claims
Native application launch, window operations, focus and manual global workspaces
Theme configuration and guarded display-setting behavior
Rime Chinese commit and native clipboard copy/paste
iwd controls and wired DHCP/DNS; private PipeWire policy and audio controls
Safe session exit, bounded failures and useful local diagnostics
Power authorization, protected locking and suspend remain deferred/disabled in Live
preserve: Existing Alpine build recipes and accepted artifacts
Own wlroots compositor and PollyUI Shell, not GNOME/KDE/labwc
No GLib/GIO/GObject dependency in our own runtime/service ELF closure
No persistence, installer or automatic update service during base migration
